articles.summary: BURLINGAME, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 3, 2026-- Upstart Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: UPST), the leading artificial intelligence (AI) lending marketplace, today published its monthly origination volume for August 2026 and its latest Upstart Macro Index (UMI) reading.
articles.title: Upstart Publishes August 2026 Originations and Latest UMI
